about_the_game:
This DLC includes the full version of expanded content for the Broken Fate base game. You will need the base game to download this DLC.

📦 Features:

  • Unlocks a secret area in the Lotus Pavilion

  • Ability to romance 1 additional love interest

  • Extra endings

⚠️ Trigger Warning:

This content contains potentially distressing material, including:

  • Obsessive behavior

  • Manipulation and emotional coercion

  • Power imbalance in romantic/psychological contexts

Player discretion is advised.

short_description: Uncover even crazier thruths and hidden desires in this mature expansion to Broken Fate. Featuring a secret area, a new love interest and more endings—this DLC deepens your journey into obsession, memory, and control. Base game required.
